statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-59244 (GHSA-f643-3rc2-j27w): Apache Airflow's secrets masker did not mask a Variable read through var.json whose value is a JSON object, so a secret stored that way and used in a template was shown in cleartext in the Rendered Templates view. Airflow 3.3.1 fixes it (https://lists.apache.org/thread/fncod6vttfo5fvmfs3h9r8s2kmm9j1n6, https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/68975): the Task SDK's airflow/sdk/execution_time/context.py gains _mask_and_deserialize_variable, which masks the deserialized value as well as the raw string. The airflow package installs Airflow and its Task SDK in its Python environment under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages. We read all 58 airflow packages for Debian 13 published in the DHI Debian repository by 2026-11-28, 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-17, amd64 and arm64 (116 package files). For every package we read its md5sums manifest, which lists every file the package installs with its digest, and matched the digests of the files that carry the fix against the same files in the released wheels on PyPI; we also unpacked the amd64 and arm64 packages of 3.3.0-0, 3.3.2-19, 3.4.0-0 and 3.4.0-17. Both architectures ship the same copy of those files in every version. 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.0-3 install Airflow 3.3.0 with Task SDK 1.3.0; their context.py is byte for byte the file in the Task SDK 1.3.0 wheel and has no _mask_and_deserialize_variable. 3.3.1-0 to 3.3.1-15 install Airflow 3.3.1 with Task SDK 1.3.1; their context.py is byte for byte the 1.3.1 wheel's and defines and uses _mask_and_deserialize_variable. 3.3.2-0 to 3.3.2-19 (Task SDK 1.3.2) and 3.4.0-0 to 3.4.0-17 (Task SDK 1.4.0) each ship one digest of the file per release, and the unpacked 3.3.2-19 and 3.4.0-17 copies keep the function. Each package has one copy of the file. 3.3.1-0 is the first published package with the fix.
